elements.name: wide busy road on edge of Addis Ababa
two young men walking side by side, seen from behind
taller young man in denim jacket carrying nothing
tall concrete buildings with lit windows
thick crowd as soft dark shapes

wrong_setting: European-style old-town pedestrian street with ornate classical facades, awnings and cast-iron lamps; pedestrians in Western winter clothing; reads as dusk or evening in a European city, not night in Addis Ababa; only one car is visible, and there are no minibus taxis.
anatomy: The central figure's hands are malformed and claw-like, with unclear fingers. The feet in the sandals look stubby and misshapen.
notes: Regenerate the frame. Show two young men walking away side by side: the shorter one in a dark jacket with a backpack, the taller one in a denim jacket. Set them at night on a wide Addis Ababa road with cars, blue-and-white minibus taxis, concrete buildings and a crowd of soft dark shapes. Remove the European facades, the garbled shop-sign lettering and the green hoodie, and fix the hands.
